text: Stripe webhooks arrive out of order. In the handler re-fetch with stripe.subscriptions.retrieve() instead of trusting event.data.object, and skip the event if event.created is older than Subscription.stripeUpdatedAt.

Local webhooks: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe`, then put the whsec_ value it prints into .env.local as STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. The route must read the raw body with `await req.text()` or signature verification fails.
Seat count is derived on the fly: count Membership rows where role != 'billing_only'.
Org.seatCount is a stored column and is the quantity we send to Stripe. Update it in the same prisma.$transaction that adds or removes the Membership. The owner counts as a seat.

Schema changes: `pnpm prisma migrate dev --name <change>` locally and commit the migration folder. Prod runs `prisma migrate deploy` in the release job. Never run `migrate reset` against the shared staging DB.
Feature flags are rows in the flags table, read through lib/flags.ts. They are cached per request with React cache(), not across requests, so a flag flip shows up on the next page load.
E2E is Cypress: `pnpm cypress open`, specs in cypress/e2e.

E2E tests are Playwright in e2e/: `pnpm test:e2e` headless, or `pnpm exec playwright test e2e/billing.spec.ts --ui` to debug one spec. Billing specs need STRIPE_SECRET_KEY set to a test-mode key (sk_test_FAKE...).
pnpm only, the packageManager field pins pnpm 9. `npm install` creates a package-lock.json that CI rejects.
Unit tests: `pnpm test` (Vitest). DB-backed tests use DATABASE_URL from .env.test; run `pnpm db:test:reset` once first.
Pages under app/(marketing) are statically generated. Calling cookies() or headers() anywhere in that route group makes the whole group dynamic and kills the CDN cache.
Server actions that change billing must call assertOrgRole(orgId, ['owner', 'admin']) first. Middleware only checks that someone is logged in, not which org they belong to.
Invoice PDF route (app/api/invoices/[id]/pdf) has to stay on the Node runtime, @react-pdf/renderer doesn't run on edge. Keep `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` in that file.
LineItemsTable rows come from react-hook-form useFieldArray. Use field.id as the React key, never the index, or focus jumps to the wrong row when one is removed.
Client CSV import (lib/import/clients.ts) streams with papaparse. Files over 5MB used to hit the 10s function limit; it now runs in a background job.

Email templates are react-email components in lib/email/templates; `pnpm email:dev` previews on :3001. Images need absolute URLs; the org logo signed URL expires after 7 days, so emails must use the public CDN variant (org.logoPublicUrl).
Conventional commits; the squash merge appends the PR number. Renovate bumps are `chore(deps)`.
Prisma is pinned at 5.x: 6.0 broke our $extends soft-delete extension. Don't merge Renovate bumps for prisma or @prisma/client.
Soft-delete extension was rewritten on query.$allModels and works on Prisma 6.4. Prisma bumps are fine again, but run the full e2e suite before merging one.
Magic-link login emails go through Resend. In dev they are printed to the server console instead of sent when EMAIL_DEV_LOG=1.
Every push to main deploys to production on Vercel once the migrate job passes. PR previews use a Neon branch database per PR.
Subscription renewal test karna ho toh Stripe test clock use karo, asli date ka wait mat karo. Fixture e2e/fixtures/testClock.ts mein hai, advance() call karke renewal trigger hota hai.
Client search uses a pg_trgm index on Client.name. Prisma can't express it, so the index lives in a hand-written SQL migration; don't delete it when Prisma reports drift.
tsconfig strict hai, `any` likhoge toh lint fail hoga. `unknown` lo aur zod se parse karo.
Dark mode is Tailwind class strategy toggled by next-themes. Render the toggle only after mount or you get a hydration warning.
If seat counts in Stripe and our DB disagree: `pnpm tsx scripts/reconcile-seats.ts --org <id> --dry-run` prints the diff; drop --dry-run to push our number to Stripe.
